scope: Original JAR bytecode for card use, queued actions, damage, powers, pile movement and choices; controlled actor setup and queue driver, mock rendering. Turn scenarios additionally execute the original action manager, room end-turn hooks and controlled Cultist or Act 1 Jaw Worm AI. Encounter scenarios execute real Cultist/Jaw Worm/Louse constructors, MonsterGroup.init, player.preBattlePrep and the room battle-start branch; player/room construction remains mocked. Fight scenarios continue through lethal card resolution or the original player death-screen constructor; stop before victory room/reward processing. Statistics/preferences and publisher integration are isolated, telemetry is disabled, death-screen run records remain temporary. Not full-game parity.
